stock.description: Hin Sang Group (International) Holding Co. Ltd., founded in 1996 and headquartered in Tsim Sha Tsui, Hong Kong, functions as a subsidiary of Genwealth Group Holding Company Limited. The company's core business revolves around developing, promoting, and selling healthcare products, with a particular emphasis on offerings for children, primarily serving the markets of Hong Kong and Mainland China. Its operations are strategically organized into four principal segments: 1. Product Development: This division focuses on creating and commercializing personal care products, household goods, and health supplements under proprietary brand names such as Hin Sang, Tai Wo Tong, Cheers Smart, Care Plus, Shuang Long, and King's Antiseptic. 2. Brand Development and Management: This unit specializes in the marketing, sales, distribution, logistics, and delivery of personal care products for brands including Pahmi, Enear, Vcnic, Zici, and Sunew, while also offering brand management and development services to other brand owners. 3. Trading of Goods: This segment handles the distribution and sale of skincare, personal care, and household products, procured from diverse sources like authorized dealers, independent traders, manufacturers, parallel importers, and various suppliers. 4. Healthcare: This division provides traditional Chinese medical services tailored for mothers and children, in addition to developing maternal and child health-related products and operating medical centers and hospitals. Beyond these primary activities, the group also engages in the trade of skincare, personal care, and slimming products, as well as property holding. The company's products are available to consumers directly in Hong Kong, through a robust distribution network spanning the People's Republic of China and Macau, and via online platforms.
